info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Prospect Campaign Design API
info.description: The Prospect Campaign Design API facilitates the retrieval of detailed designs associated with marketing campaigns aimed at potential clients. This endpoint allows marketing teams to access and analyze campaign components, enhancing strategies for customer engagement and outreach. Typical consumers include marketing professionals and data analysts who require insights into campaign effectiveness. By using this API, organizations can better tailor their marketing efforts and optimize prospecting strategies.

get.description: Fetches the details of the specific marketing prospect campaign design identified by the resource ID RES-100045. This endpoint allows you to view the campaign's configuration, status, and related metrics to support your marketing efforts.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information regarding the prospect campaign design. It contains the necessary parameters to filter and structure the data returned by the API based on the provided specifications.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the requested campaign design data.
